title: Does snipping the arms reduce the angle?
description: A girl snips the ends of a rotating arm and says the angle is reduced, while a boy says it is still the same. The snipped arm is laid over the old one to see who is right, and then the angle is really reduced by turning one arm. Keeko's doubt is that shorter arms mean a smaller angle.
teaching_notes: One idea: the size of an angle depends on the turn between the arms, not on their length. Watch for students who think shorter arms make a smaller angle.
